# House Bound Via Auth Marker
utils/portal-user.js introduces houseBoundViaAuth flag, set true only when LingXi authCode house selection succeeds via mergeLingXiHouseIntoPortalUser, used as the formal-version house-binding criterion.
## Behavior
- houseBoundViaAuth defined in utils/portal-user.js, set true only on successful mergeLingXiHouseIntoPortalUser
- externalWebview.vue hasHouse now checks this flag to determine house presence
- refreshPortalProfile no longer fills house fields from ctUserIdentity
## Scope
- Formal version requires LingXi authCode selection success to count as house binding
- Trial version ignores this flag; houseList/houseId presence counts as bound

# Active House Unified Reader
getActiveHouseFromPortalUser added in utils/portal-user.js unifies active-house reading to fix menu inconsistency caused by snapshot field conflicts after house switching.
## Problem
- mergeCtUserIdentityHouseIntoPortalUser forced houseId/project to override LingXi-selected values
- Menu value fields inconsistent: getPortalComplexId preferred project/houseList[0], portalUser.houseId, buildPortalH5FlatQuery mixed sources
## Solution
- New getActiveHouseFromPortalUser in utils/portal-user.js provides single source for active house
- Menu and community name both read via this function

# Community Switch Card
home.vue adds community-card between carousel and menu; shows switch entry when houseList.length > 1, calls syncPortalHouseSelection to update houseId/project and write snapshot.
## Behavior
- community-card inserted between swiper and menu grid in home.vue
- Visible only when portalUser.houseList.length > 1
- Selection calls syncPortalHouseSelection to update houseId/project and persist snapshot
## Constraints
- Menu grid and bottom tab bar remain unchanged
- Community name sourced from getActiveHouseFromPortalUser
